title: Founding Software Engineer (Next.js, Python) LATAM
description:
ONLY LATAM REGION

Founding Software Engineer (Full-Stack, Frontend-heavy)
Fully Remote
About the role
We’re looking for a hands-on Founding Software Engineer who wants real ownership from day one. You’ll work closely with the founding team, shape the product, and have a direct impact on both technical decisions and user experience.
This is a full-stack role with a strong frontend focus. Ideal for someone who enjoys moving fast, solving complex problems, and building products end-to-end.
Responsibilities
Build and improve core product features using Next.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and Python
Own frontend architecture and deliver high-quality, performant user interfaces
Collaborate closely with the team on product decisions and technical direction
Move quickly, iterate based on feedback, and ship meaningful improvements
Contribute to both frontend and backend as needed

Requirements
Strong experience with Next.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript
Solid full-stack skills (comfortable with Python on the backend)
Proven experience building real products (not just features)
Ability to work independently and take ownership
Comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment

Nice to have
Experience in early-stage startups or founding teams
Strong product sense and attention to UX details
Familiarity with modern frontend tooling and best practices

What we offer
Fully remote work
Real ownership and influence from day one
Direct impact on the product and technical decisions
Opportunity to shape both the product and engineering culture

If you like building products, moving fast, and having a meaningful impact — we’d love to hear from you.
